study type: Preclinical randomized animal study and Phase 1 human safety trial
cohort: Forty pigs with dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) induced by intracoronary microspheres, and five pediatric patients with DCM and reduced ejection fraction.
finding: Intracoronary CDC administration was safe and improved cardiac function through CDCex in a porcine model of DCM, and a 1-year safety lead-in in pediatric patients showed a favorable safety profile and preliminary efficacy.
